on_need_replan.desc: Refresh when a replan is needed (alignment failure, etc.).

on_planner_invalid_step.desc: Refresh when planner outputs an invalid step.

min_step_gap_steps.desc: Minimum step gap between maintainer runs. 0 disables gap-based throttling.

every_n_plans.desc: For Reflexion only, run maintenance every N newly generated plans.

history_window_steps.desc: Recent step window injected into task_progress maintenance.

min_failures_to_reflect.desc: Failure-count threshold within the recent failure window before triggering failure-based reflection.

failure_window_steps.desc: Count failures within the most recent N executed steps for failure-based reflection.

min_reflection_gap_steps.desc: Minimum executed-step gap between two reflections to avoid repeated firing in the same deadlock region.

reflect_every_n_steps.desc: Run lightweight periodic reflection every N executed steps. 0 disables periodic reflection.

reflect_on_loop.desc: Reflect when the same step pattern repeats in a short recent window.

loop_window_steps.desc: How many recent executed steps to inspect for loop-like repetition.

loop_repeat_threshold.desc: Trigger loop reflection when the same step type/name repeats this many times in the recent window.

memory_window_size.desc: Number of recent reflections kept in reflexion_memory as a sliding window.

max_reflections.desc: Maximum number of reflections in one run.

history_window_steps.desc: Recent STM steps injected into reflection prompt.
